Source repository: https://github.com/rime/rime-pinyin-simp

Downloaded files:
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rime/rime-pinyin-simp/0c6861ef7420ee780270ca6d993d18d4101049d0/LICENSE
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rime/rime-pinyin-simp/0c6861ef7420ee780270ca6d993d18d4101049d0/pinyin_simp.dict.yaml

License: Apache-2.0

This directory keeps the raw simplified Chinese Rime dictionary in the git repository so `src/data/zh-ime-confusions.generated.ts` can be regenerated. The npm package publishes the generated compact data and license/source notice files, not the full raw dictionary by default.
